status: proposed-only; not included by the generator or callable by mods
integration: Merge into the appropriate client and server catalogs, allocate IDs, review types and capabilities, then regenerate WIT and adapters together.

hooks.name: config_changed
hooks.contract: Fired only after a validated change takes effect; synced keys are server-authoritative.

hooks.name: payload_received
hooks.contract: Deliver to the same mod on the receiving side; player is the authenticated sender on the server.

hooks.name: payload_transfer_progress
hooks.contract: Progress is scoped to the mod, peer and transfer; a completed transfer is delivered once.

services.name: config_get
services.contract: Read the calling mod's declared value. Exactly the field indicated by kind is meaningful.

services.name: config_set
services.contract: Validate before persisting and notifying; clients cannot set server-authoritative keys.

services.name: has_permission
services.contract: Only declared nodes may be granted; explicit player rule overrides the declared op-level default.

services.name: mod_payload_to_server
services.contract: Authenticated same-mod channel; maximum 1 MiB per message and subject to rate limits.

services.name: mod_payload_to_player
services.contract: Authenticated same-mod channel; maximum 1 MiB per message and subject to rate limits.

services.name: mod_payload_broadcast
services.contract: Send to eligible connected peers of the same mod, with per-peer and aggregate rate limits.

services.name: payload_transfer_begin
services.contract: Reserve a bounded transfer of at most 64 MiB for an authenticated mod and peer.

services.name: payload_transfer_write
services.contract: Accept chunks at 1 MiB-aligned offsets, with exactly 1 MiB except for the final chunk; identical retries are idempotent and mismatched retries fail.

services.name: payload_transfer_resume
services.contract: Report progress only for the authorized owner and peer; retention lifetime needs agreement.

services.name: payload_transfer_missing_chunks
services.contract: Return missing zero-based chunk indices only to the authorized owner and peer.

services.name: payload_transfer_finish
services.contract: Deliver the complete authorized transfer once; reject incomplete or already completed transfers.

services.name: payload_transfer_cancel
services.contract: Release the authorized transfer's reservations.

services.name: http_request
services.contract: Requires declared service.http, per-mod user approval and a declared HTTPS host; validate every resolved address and redirect, pin the approved DNS result, and bound sizes, time and concurrency.

services.name: http_poll
services.contract: Poll only a ticket owned by the calling mod; none means pending.

services.name: storage_get
services.contract: Access only the calling mod's client or server store; missing keys return none and values over 1 MiB require blob reads.

services.name: storage_put
services.contract: Atomic bounded write; enforce at most 256 MiB per mod per world, without symlink or junction escape.

services.name: storage_delete
services.contract: Delete only the calling mod's key and release its quota.

services.name: storage_blob_begin
services.contract: Reserve quota before receiving a blob; partial writes are not visible as committed values.

services.name: storage_blob_write
services.contract: Write bounded chunks to an owned pending blob; preserve its quota reservation.

services.name: storage_blob_commit
services.contract: Atomically publish only a complete, quota-reserved blob.

services.name: storage_blob_abort
services.contract: Discard an owned pending blob and release its reserved quota.

services.name: storage_blob_read
services.contract: Read a bounded slice of a committed value.

services.name: chunk_ticket_acquire
services.contract: Idempotently hold a capped per-mod chunk ticket; release on unload or world shutdown.

services.name: chunk_ticket_release
services.contract: Release only the calling mod's ticket.

services.name: backup_request
services.contract: Use the existing save pipeline; rate-limit and report completion asynchronously.

services.name: backup_poll
services.contract: Poll only an owned backup ticket; none means pending, true means success and false means failure.

services.name: server_performance
services.contract: Report measured MSPT and TPS, with a documented sampling window.

services.name: locate_begin
services.contract: Bound radius, work and concurrency; do not block the game thread.

services.name: locate_poll
services.contract: Poll only an owned ticket; the position is present if and only if the status is found.

services.name: client_mod_call
services.contract: Match the server mod-call contract: 1 MiB request and response, bounded nesting and no re-entry into a waiting caller.
